trigger: agent, chat, branch, or operator ownership changes

steps.action: Run the status reporter to emit current JSON, Markdown, and handoff artifacts.
Record exact branch, HEAD, PR, files, validators, skipped checks, preserved worktrees, blockers, proof achieved, and proof ceiling.
Provide one exact command that advances the first unproven gate and resolves its canonical artifact.
Require the receiving agent to re-read AGENTS.md, codebase map, manifest, workflows, and current Git/PR state.

failurePolicy: Do not claim completion when a validator, outer entrypoint, hosted check, review, merge, or operator-runtime gate remains unproved.
proofCeiling: Compressed repository continuation state; the receiver must refresh every mutable fact.
